vehicleVisit.title: Vehicle lifecycle control
vehicleVisit.subtitle: One visit, from arrival to signed handover
vehicleVisit.locationUnavailable: Current location could not be loaded; retry
vehicleVisit.noLinkedEntry: No vehicle entry is linked to this visit yet
vehicleVisit.customerApproved: I confirm the customer approved this cash repair; this does not record a payment
vehicleVisit.cashFlow: Cash flow: approval records consent to repair, not payment or invoicing.
vehicleVisit.insuranceFlow: Insurance flow: approval comes from the insurance claim; cash consent is not used.
vehicleVisit.approvalPermissionRequired: Only an authorized manager or insurance officer may approve this stage.
vehicleVisit.workPermissionRequired: Only an authorized manager, supervisor, or technician may start work.
vehicleVisit.completionPermissionRequired: Only an authorized manager or supervisor may confirm readiness or delivery.
vehicleVisit.claimApprovalRequired: Approve the insurance claim first; the vehicle stage updates automatically after the approval is saved.
vehicleVisit.cashWorkOrderRequired: Create and link a cash work order before recording customer approval.
vehicleVisit.workOrderRequired: Create and link a work order before starting the repair.
vehicleVisit.workshopPresenceRequired: Confirm the vehicle is in the workshop before starting the repair.
vehicleVisit.workOrderStatusInvalid: The work order status does not allow repair to start. Review it first.
vehicleVisit.cancelClaimFirst: Cancel the linked insurance claim before cancelling this visit.
vehicleVisit.closeWorkOrderFirst: A linked active work order requires a separate resolution before cancelling this visit. Do not record a fictitious delivery.
vehicleVisit.insuranceClaimFirst: This is an insurance visit; create or link its claim before creating a work order.
vehicleVisit.workOrderLinkNotConfirmed: The work-order link was not confirmed in the cloud. Reopen the entry before retrying.
vehicleVisit.insurance_claim_required: Insurance details exist but no claim is linked. This cannot be treated as cash.
vehicleVisit.work_order_channel_conflict: The work order type or claim link does not match the cash/insurance flow; review the link before advancing.
vehicleVisit.cancelled_with_active_work_order: The claim or visit is cancelled but the work order is still active. Review its closure, handover, and accounting before treating the vehicle as fully cancelled.
vehicleVisit.reviewCustodyDescription: Only after physically checking that the vehicle is in the workshop, correct the linked custody records with an audited reason. Older visits are never corrected in bulk.
vehicleVisit.physicallyChecked: I personally verified that the vehicle is in the workshop now
vehicleVisit.custodySaved: Vehicle custody correction was recorded and verified in the cloud
